source: This does not mean gradients can never vanish or explode in a deep Transformer. Normalization, initialization, parameter scale, optimizer dynamics, and the composition of many blocks still matter. But the direct identity path is the structural reason residual architectures can preserve and refine representations instead of forcing every layer to relearn them from scratch. [2]
zh: 这并不意味着梯度在深层 Transformer 中永远不会消失或爆炸。归一化、初始化、参数规模、优化器动态以及许多块的组成仍然很重要。但直接身份路径是残差架构可以保留和细化表示的结构原因，而不是强迫每一层从头开始重新学习它们。 [2]
